standard_prerequisites.name: Model theory of abelian groups, Szmielew invariants, primitive-positive formulas and stability ranks
standard_prerequisites.statement: Full author preliminaries and cited standard statements, complete ultraproduct constructions and counting proofs, exact-class definitions and appendix rank arguments retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: All mathematical context from the original paper and its complete pseudo_groups.bib preserved.

core_obligations: Constructs infinite-index definable subgroup chains for the lower SU-rank bound, reduces dividing chains to parameter-free positive primitive groups, and bounds each successive index using the finite list of prime-power invariants to obtain equality in the pseudofinite case.
difficulty_reason: Constructs infinite-index definable subgroup chains for the lower SU-rank bound, reduces dividing chains to parameter-free positive primitive groups, and bounds each successive index using the finite list of prime-power invariants to obtain equality in the pseudofinite case.

dedup.scope: Focused fixed-source and pseudofinite-abelian/Szmielew/exact-class/rank metadata lookup against all three indexes found no related primary. Main targets are pseudofinite classification, exact definable counting and the SU-rank formula. Omega-stable specialization, direct-sum support theorems and resulting stability dichotomy are not separately counted.
